rationale: ALNY has gapped down ~20% on massive relative volume (12x), suggesting a significant catalyst event (likely earnings or clinical data), and is currently trading at 44% of its intraday range with price below both VWAP ($194.57) and the 9-EMA ($192.18) — indicating sellers remain in control. However, the stock has already bounced ~$10 off the session low ($179.87), making both a short entry (chasing a move already underway) and a long entry (fighting the dominant downtrend with price below key intraday levels) unattractive risk/reward propositions at this moment. With no news context available to anchor a directional thesis and two working orders already consuming buying power, the prudent action is to wait for clearer structure.
